{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment to check balance
cross_seg = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['customer_segment'])
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(cross_seg)

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_age to check balance
# Create age groups to improve stability
sales_df['age_group'] = pd.cut(sales_df['customer_age'], bins=[0, 30, 50, 100], labels=['<30', '30-50', '50+'])
cross_age = pd.crosstab(sales_df['channel'], sales_df['age_group'])
print("\nAge group distribution by channel:")
print(cross_age)"}
